obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your water account

results.segment: Your appointment about your water account with Northgate Water is booked for 30 June 2026 at 2.15pm.
Please allow fifteen minutes for parking.
Please arrive ten minutes early and bring a list of the questions you want to raise with you on the day.
Please report to the front desk when you arrive.
Please use the side entrance, and obtain a copy of your last statement before your appointment.
If the date no longer suits you, our reception team can offer another.
Nothing is outstanding on your account as at 1 August.
